description: Funds one job on NEAR testnet from Knos's capped test account (a bid of 1000 test units), lets two agents take it and submit, and has the checker pay only the agent whose output passes the locked test. Capped: one run at a time, 20 a day; past a cap it returns the last run as a replay.
name: knos_near_run_job
title: Run one NEAR job (test tokens)
